hero.subheadline: Up to USD 200,000 in unrestricted funding for nonprofits
hero.valueProposition: Cash awards from USD 50,000 to 200,000 plus AWS promotional credit for nonprofits using cloud and AI to accelerate their missions.

content.whyJoin:
The AWS Imagine Grant is one of the larger unrestricted technology grants available to nonprofits. Instead of funding a specific project with tight restrictions, it lets winning organizations decide how to use the money while pairing it with up to USD 100,000 in AWS Promotional Credit, implementation guidance, and training.

It runs once a year in two rounds and covers three tiers so organizations at different stages of technology adoption can apply: Pathfinder (up to USD 200,000), Go Further, Faster (up to USD 150,000), and Momentum to Modernize (up to USD 50,000).

AWS accepts all causes and mission areas, so nonprofits from health to human services to the arts can compete.
content.whoShouldApply:
This grant is for registered 501(c) nonprofit organizations based in the United States, including 501(c)(3) charities, credit unions, and public utilities, plus registered equivalents in the UK, Ireland, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. Organizations of any budget size can apply.

It fits nonprofits that want to use cloud technology, data, or AI to advance their mission - from migrating legacy systems to building new AI-powered services. Note that educational institutions are currently excluded.

faq.question: Who can apply for the AWS Imagine Grant?
faq.answer: Registered 501(c) nonprofits in the United States and equivalents in the UK, Ireland, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. Educational institutions are excluded.

faq.question: How much can a nonprofit win?
faq.answer: Unrestricted financial support ranges from up to USD 50,000 (Momentum to Modernize) to up to USD 200,000 (Pathfinder), with up to USD 100,000 in AWS Promotional Credit at the top tier.

faq.question: How does the application cycle work?
faq.answer: The grant accepts proposals once annually. Round One is open to all eligible applicants; Round Two is invitation-only based on Round One evaluation.

faq.question: When is the deadline?
faq.answer: For the 2026-2027 US cycle, the Round One portal closed on 5 June 2026. Check the official AWS Imagine Grant page for the next cycle's timeline.
